correctness.rationale: All-size proof derives weak best responses for all core/periphery player types, enumerates exactly the allowed occupancy families and binomial multiplicities, optimizes the explicit cut via concave integer quadratic, and identifies all worst and best equilibrium cuts including c=1 and m=1 boundaries. value.rationale: An exact finite-parameter classification for a natural clique-hub/independent-periphery social network sharply separates odd core sizes (all equilibria efficient) from even core sizes (nonoptimal equilibria with price of anarchy tending to 2). The complete labeled census quantifies the prevalence of the inefficient central ties and provides an interpretable baseline for anti-coordination welfare.
